content.title: Abbott narrows outlook, Australian stocks react to US-China trade
content.description:
Yahoo Finance host Josh Lipton tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including Abbott Laboratories (ABT) shares slipping after the company narrowed its full-year guidance, Amphenol (APH) receiving an upgrade to Buy, and Australian stocks — like Australian Oilseeds (COOT) — are reacting to the rare earth trade tensions between the US and China.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
